title: The Next Viral Game Might Be AI-Generated. Why Not Yours?
author: CuntsAndBluntss
selftext:
At some point, an AI-generated or vibe-coded game is going to absolutely blow up. Maybe it'll attract millions of players, compete with AAA titles, or become the next unexpected indie success story. At least that is what I truly believe, unlike what some critics might think. Hence why I created this platform.

The problem isn't always building a great game. Sometimes it's getting people to discover it in the first place.

That's exactly why I created VibeToplist.

We're building a discovery platform dedicated entirely to AI-assisted and vibe-coded games, already attracting thousands of visitors every week who are actively looking for new games to play, follow, and wishlist.

**If you're working on a game, here's why you should list it:**

* Get your project in front of an audience genuinely interested in AI-assisted games.
* Gain additional exposure and a backlink to help improve your SEO.
* Build awareness and attract potential players before launch.
* **Completely free to submit.**

I genuinely believe we're still incredibly early in this space. A year or two from now, the landscape could look completely different.

Your game might be one of the projects that helps shape it.

**Discover games or submit yours:** [https://vibetoplist.com/](https://vibetoplist.com/)

comments.author: TheAuthorBTLG_
comments.body:
I'd like to put Memory Dive forward for VibeToplist. I'm the developer behind BrainLiftGames. It's a first-person investigation and escape-room game: you explore a reconstructed memory, connect evidence in a case database, and separate recovered facts from details the reconstruction invented.



There's a free Steam demo, and we're participating in Next Fest on October 19–26:

[https://store.steampowered.com/app/5014590/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5014590/)



We use AI throughout development for coding, mixed human/AI writing, 3D geometry through code and Blender, artwork, music, sound and voices, under my direction and review. The finished game has no runtime AI generation or external AI connections. AI also assisted with this comment.



Can you consider it for a listing from these details, or is submission through an account on your site required?

replies.author: CuntsAndBluntss
replies.body: Submission through the platform is required, meaning you would have to create an account on our platform and list your game.

comments.author: jazzuoDOTcom
comments.body: Ok why do you thing we are still early in the game? I feel, specially coming to reddit, I am late in the game.

replies.body: Early in the sense that AI is still improving, so are the games and ideas. There will be a vastly popular completely vibe-coded game at some point. Jump on that train before it forever left the station.
